# T6: summary ends with a TOTAL line

Add stocklib.report.totals(ledger) returning the sum of all quantities as an int, and make stocklib.report.summary(ledger) end with a final line 'TOTAL <n>' where n is that sum. The summary of an empty ledger is exactly 'TOTAL 0'. Every other summary line is unchanged.
------
diff --git a/stocklib/report.py b/stocklib/report.py
index f1bab8d..7e6d7f2 100644
--- a/stocklib/report.py
+++ b/stocklib/report.py
@@ -1,6 +1,11 @@
 """Plain-text reports over a Ledger."""
 
 
+def totals(ledger):
+    return int(sum(ledger.quantity(sku) for sku in ledger.skus()))
+
+
 def summary(ledger):
     lines = [f"{sku}: {ledger.quantity(sku)}" for sku in ledger.skus()]
+    lines.append(f"TOTAL {totals(ledger)}")
     return "\n".join(lines)
